appearance.identity: Twin pale-steel through-truss crossings on retained concrete piers; shorter pony end spans.
appearance.exclusions: Separate curved concrete approach, later neighboring bridge, engineering river datum and full hardware inventory.

brief: Compact Gandhi Setu: twin through-truss decks,16representative Warren bays in each main closeup span, crossed roof bracing, concrete pier heads, outer walks, sparse lights/markings and shorter pony spans. Original detailed I-sections and hardware remain independently reproducible.

sourceFacts.supplierRecord: Dextra India engineering case study credited to its application engineer; original span schedule and retained piers.
sourceFacts.reviewScope: Original999896-triangle/81075924-byte master reproduced exactly; independent medium-fi shells use shared painted metal/concrete.

limitations: Picture and standard viewer PMTiles approximate fit; no bespoke bridge survey, engineering drawing or datum research.

Original detailed master remains reproduced by its unchanged recipe and geometric map controls; compact source simplifies I-section profiles, bolts/gussets, bearings, floor/roof bracing and fittings into readable beams and shared metal/concrete materials.

Skyline merges paired piers/decks and representative outer trusses; district/street omit many truss panels and inner fine members, while closeup retains16main Warren bays. Road/paint markings are local flat materials; shared graphs are reused.

Reference aerial picture is an intermediate replacement state; existing twin-steel source facts are retained separately. River surface and northern-road contact use coarse PMTiles; exact flood stage, submerged foundations, approach joins and physical-device timing remain unmeasured. Footprint replacement off.
